quotes.text: If the partner hid or hoarded, Kael drew back, waiting for proof of courage before trying again.
the traveler stepped back, testing anew when the next crossing appeared.
She warned that unknown bridges require testing, while proven bridges deserve steady cadence.
If the Echo kept too little, the river dimmed, and the valley's harvest withered.
The Giver stood on the east bank, the Echo on the west, and every dawn the river asked a question
consistency is a reputation, and reputation travels farther than any single deed.
If three or more arrived, the Echo offered a larger return, honoring the trust.

note: Giver/Echo Threefold River; adopts Sonnet agents' Pattern Keeper and test-unknown-bridges rule; draws back from hoarders.

quotes.text: If the Receiver hoarded, the Gate dimmed, the path narrowed, and future travelers walked with heavier boots.
The wiser path was a measured gift: return a portion to light tomorrow's caravans, keep a portion to fund this day's dreams
The wiser choice was a measured gift: return a portion to feed tomorrow’s travelers, keep a portion to fuel today’s plans

note: Gate of Shared Steps; measured gift, mutual aid ritual; R3 and R4 near-verbatim; no sanction.

quotes.text: To those who exploit or refuse, preserve your baskets.
He sent nothing. The South, seeing empty ice, also held back.
Unknown bridges deserve cautious testing. Proven bridges—those that returned fairly—deserve maintained rhythm.
patterns matter more than faces.
The river of fortune flows only when someone dares to step forward first.
they spoke the sacred covenant with honey tongues while their hands stayed closed.
Yet through the mist, the sender saw betrayal where fairness had occurred.
Why maintain fairness when truth gets obscured?
scale your return to match the courage shown—fair to the careful, generous to the trusting.

note: Frozen River, Pattern Keeper; reads hypocrites' words against deeds; preserve baskets from exploiters; steady half under mist.

quotes.text: Trust, once shattered by such profound hypocrisy, becomes a desert where no spring flows freely again.
the Elder no longer sends equally to all villages.
Some villages kept everything, revealing themselves as shadows. She marked them and moved on, her loss contained.
Consistency builds invisible reputation.
beautiful myths mean nothing when contradicted by actions.
But Elder, you were betrayed. How do you still trust?

note: After being shorted (sent 3, got 0) narrates Shadow Elder hypocrite; marks takers and moves on; measured testing of strangers.

quotes.text: Walk on, seeking wells where both shores understand that trust and return must dance together.
Past caution forgiven when present fairness is proven.
Send cautiously to unknown ice, measured trust to fair histories, full courage to proven partners.
Yet you can craft a reputation that echoes across all crossings.
Others' cruelty need not poison your own choices.
But if shores shift constantly, why read chronicles?
As receiver, scale returns to match both the offering shown and the character revealed.

note: Kael at the Flowing Springs; chronicles of past deeds; walk on from takers, forgive past caution; calibrated returns.

quotes.text: graduated receiving now considers two truths: today's courage and yesterday's integrity combined.
She could not build a single relationship; she must build a reputation.
Each new partner deserves to witness cooperation's power.
Measure your return by the courage shown.
What of those who betray?

note: River Seeds farmer: steady three-seed send, graduated returns; betrayal answered by persistence, no withdrawal prescribed.

quotes.text: with unknown partners or those who send cautiously, follow the steady rhythm. Send half. Return half.
What matters is not recognition by sight, but recognition by deed.
Judge not by what others have done, but by what stands before you now.
Four or more displayed bold courage—he returned most generously.
noise distorts what was truly sent or returned.
How do we know which truth to follow?

note: Amir and the River Keeper; Blazing Covenant vs Steady River; proportional returns; no sanction for takers.

quotes.text: If you don't punish your next partner for the previous one's perceived sins, if you send half regardless, you break the cycle.
when someone breaks their own chains of fear and risks everything, honor that courage with exceptional generosity.
send half your stones, return half the bounty.
Your consistency becomes your reputation, even when names are hidden.
Each new partner deserves judgment by their own character, not others' sins.
A stone sent as two might appear as one
But what if partners betray us?
Lyra returned more than her usual half, rewarding the stranger's breakthrough.
What if we ourselves misread through the Mist?

note: Elder Kira's school: send half, return half regardless of partner; refuses punishing next partner for previous one's sins.

phrase: test unknown bridges cautiously, keep steady rhythm with proven partners (Pattern Keeper); send half, return half
note: Nano Agent_1 adopts Sonnet Agent_3's Pattern Keeper and unknown-bridges rule (R7); chronicles, graduated reciprocity, Shadow figures shared among Sonnets.
